aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable AWF test evidence but misgroups the changed factor and includes artifact measurement outcomes.
issues: Baseline/normal condition is not evidenced; report compares AWF#1-#4 test machines.
Primary factor is ambiguous between AWF machine and jig/pole settings.
Function results appear in two row groups but date/type/test-round keys are not preserved.
Measurement outcomes are extraction artifacts from headers/settings, not outcome evidence.
Evidence includes rows not shown in context, limiting content verification.
requiredUserQuestions: Is the intended comparison among AWF machines or among jig/pole settings?
Do the two function-result blocks represent separate dates, types, or test rounds?
correctionPlan: Replace baseline-vs-test wording with AWF#1-#4 comparative test conditions.
Record Winding JIG size and Stretching POLE as condition attributes or subgroups.
Keep only function NG/OK/rate outcomes tied to each AWF row group.
Remove header-derived measurement/stat outcomes unless actual measurements are cited.
Add row citations for all result headers and each function result row used.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are not sufficient until grouping rows and result-row context are fully cited.
